dialogue.text: <Jasmine> That gun ain't gonna shoot itself girl.
<Chloe> AH- oh um... Yeah no, I've been ready... yeah for sure- I've done this before.. ahah.. phew.
<Jasmine> Girl don't lie to me... I know you shitting yourself right now, haha.
<Chloe> Okay... dang it. I might be a tiny bit nervous. It's just... it's my first time doing something this big. A movie, with rich demon people...
<Chloe> And look at me, a nervous wreck. I can't believe it's actually happening. I really can't... like W-w what if my movie flops?
<Chloe> W-what if people hate it? All of these thoughts, my anxiety is through the roof right now!
<Jasmine> I know, Chloe. You're not alone on this one. If I'm gonna be honest with you, I'm actually a bit nervous myself.
<Chloe> Y-you don't look like it... you know, I bet you're saying that to make me feel better. How do you even manage?
<Jasmine> How do I manage? I don't... I just try to do my best. And that's all we could ever do. Don't get me wrong, I'm still scared but you have take a leap of faith.
<Jasmine> Look how about this; do you wanna rehearse together? We don't start filming until a few hours. Maybe it'll help both of us calm our nerves, y'know?
<Chloe> Yes! I would love to! Only if you don't mind! I don't wanna mess up and panic or anything.
<Jasmine> Oh shut up! You're gonna do great girl, come on. Let's walk.
<Jasmine> So normally, I'd say to not have expectations in general because you'll just disappoint yourself when things doesn't go the way you expected.
<Jasmine> But for stuff like this, expect to mess up. I know when I first started, mostly everyone made fun of me and- Chloe, I know you're not grabbing my ass.
<Chloe> H-hand slipped while we were walking. S-sorry ma'am. However, yes, I guess I understand... we miss one hundred percent of the shot we don't take... fuck it.
